subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
Which of the following is/are true? 
 
(a) NOR gate is equivalent to NAND gate with 
bubbled inputs. 
 
(b) OR gate is equivalent to NAND gate with 
bubbled inputs. 
 
(c) AND gate is equivalent to NOR gate with 
bubbled inputs. 
 
(d) NAND gate is equivalent to NOR gate with 
bubbled inputs. 
 
[MCQ]

options.text: NOR gate is equivalent to NAND gate with
OR gate is equivalent to NAND gate with
AND gate is equivalent to NOR gate with
NAND gate is equivalent to NOR gate with

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-03 (Combinational Circuits).
